## 1. Channel Progression Strategy

This curriculum organizes the core disciplines of What If & Alternative Reality across four progressive tiers:
- **Tier 1: Counterfactual Historical Methodology, Divergence Points & Minimum Mutation Rules (Beginner / Scratch)** — Point of divergence (POD) mechanics, the 'plausibility test' and minimum alteration principle, counterfactual historiography standards (Niall Ferguson, E.H. - **Tier 4: Cosmic & Physical Law Alterations (Speed of Light Halving, Gravity Reversing, Many-Worlds Branches) (Advanced / Masterclass)** — Altering fine-structure constants and fundamental physical limits, macroscopic quantum many-worlds branching topologies, vacuum decay speed of light wavefronts, and rigorous speculative worldbuilding.
